questions.question: At the end of his letter to the believers in Thessalonica, what did Paul ask them to do for his team?
Paul asked the believers in Thessalonica to pray that his team would be delivered from what?
Paul asked the believers in Thessalonica to pray for the word of the Lord. What did he want to happen to it?

answers.text: It spreads quickly and is honored
It stays hidden until the right time
It is kept among the church leaders

questions.question: Paul told the believers in Thessalonica that the Lord is faithful. What did he say the Lord will do for them?

answers.text: Strengthen and guard them from the evil one
Take away every trouble in their lives
Bring Paul back to stay with them
